text.description_html:
Brass Accents Decorative L'Enfant Door Pull Plate 3" Wide x 23" High

This decorative Door Pull. Based on the Russian design made popular in the 1920's this piece features the classical dolphin and cornucopia under a strong transom arched top. Comes complete with matching finish mounting screws.

Brass Accents provides distinctive craftsmanship with old-world tradition for a lifetime of elegance, hand finished in the USA. They are one of the worlds leading crafters of decorative hot-forged and cast brass door hardware.

Also Available: Matching Decorative L'Enfant Push Plate

Specifications for L'Enfant Brass Accents A04-P6601 Decorative Pull Plate

  • Plate Width: 3"
  • Plate Height: 23-3/8"
  • Pull Handle Projection: 2.75"
  • Material: Cast Brass

Comes complete with matching finish mounting screws for easy installation.

***This item is discontinued. Limited quantities available.
